items.title: Data center demand drives 66% surge in natural gas power plant costs
items.content: Natural gas power plant costs have nearly doubled in two years and take 23% longer to build as data center electricity demand skyrockets.

items.title: Converge Bio raises $25M, backed by Bessemer and execs from Meta, OpenAI, Wiz
items.content: AI drug discovery startup Converge Bio raised $25 million in a Series A led by Bessemer Venture Partners, with additional backing from executives at Meta, OpenAI, and Wiz.
